messages:
maya: heads-up — we plan a v2 cutover tonight 02:00 UTC. Found mobile SDKs dropping X-Api-Version on empty 204s, which may make clients silently stay on v1.

sam: any impacted tenants?

jordan: telemetry flags 3: acme-corp, oldbank, game-studio. low qps but mobile-first.

maya: plan: pin those three to v1 during window, add proxy metric client_header_missing.count by tenant, and delay shifting them until SDK patch lands.

sam: paste deploy-bot pin commands?

jordan: `/deploybot pin tenant:acme-corp v1 --until 2026-04-02T06:00Z` (repeat for oldbank, game-studio).

deploy-bot: pinned tenants: acme-corp, oldbank, game-studio (expires 2026-04-02T06:00Z).

ops: will add probe + Grafana tile; alert if client_header_missing.count > 5 for 5m per tenant. Also add auto-pause hook for spike. ETA 20m.

maya: rollback triggers: 15m client 5xx > 2% OR P95 +300ms OR deploy-bot report >10% canary failures -> pause and unpin.

sam: updating release notes and docs: "Mobile SDK <3.1 may omit header on empty responses; recommend upgrade or request pin." PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2748

jordan: fallback option: temporary shim treating missing header as v1 per-tenant, only if pin causes issues.

maya: schedule: start 2026-04-01T02:00Z with sequential(5%,25%,50%,100%), watch 15m, ops oncall first hour. i'll monitor channel.

deploy-bot: scheduled job start=2026-04-01T02:00:00Z strategy=sequential(5,25,50,100) watch=15m operators=(maya,ops).

ops: probe + dashboard done, will ping when job starts.

maya: thanks, will post updates during the window.
